headline: Gmail Live AI search searches your inbox with voice commands
summary: Google rolls out conversational AI search for Gmail, Docs, and Keep, but only for AI plan subscribers.
details: Gmail's search is getting a significant upgrade with the new Gmail Live feature, now available for Google AI plan subscribers. This AI-powered functionality allows users to search their inbox using natural, conversational voice commands, making it easier to find specific information without sifting through endless email threads.

The feature is designed to answer questions like 'What's my flight's gate number?' or 'What's going on at my kid's school this week?' by scanning your inbox and providing quick, accurate answers. This moves beyond basic keyword searches to a more intuitive, human-like interaction with your email.

Similar 'Live' functionality is also being integrated into Google Docs and Google Keep. Docs Live will help users create first drafts of documents by pulling relevant details from Gmail, Drive, Chat, and the web, while also assisting with tone refinement.

Keep Live aims to transform 'brain dumps' into organized notes. Users can speak their ideas, and Keep Live will capture, structure, and refine them into actionable lists and notes, eliminating the need for manual typing. For example, a request for painting supplies and instructions can be automatically generated.

These new voice-activated features are rolling out this week for Gmail and Keep users subscribed to Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra plans. Docs Live is currently limited to Pro and Ultra subscribers. Google also stated that these features will be available for Google Workspace business customers soon.

topic: ai builds its own ui with open intelligent ui
headline_marked: [[AI Can Now Build Its Own UI]] With Open Intelligent UI
headline: AI Can Now Build Its Own UI With Open Intelligent UI
summary: Explore how generative UI turns natural language requests into interactive interfaces, making AI applications more dynamic and user-friendly.
details: Generative UI allows AI-powered applications to create interactive interfaces from natural language requests. This means users can go beyond simple text answers and interact with structured content, forms, tables, and maps.

OpenUI is an open standard that provides tooling for developers to build AI applications with rich, interactive interfaces. The OpenUI Gateway offers access to various AI models through a common API, allowing developers to choose models that fit their budget and needs.

The Open Intelligent UI demo application, available in an open-source repository, lets developers experiment with different prompts and see how the AI generates interfaces. Running the demo locally requires Node.js and an OpenUI Cloud API Key.

While generative UI offers new possibilities for AI assistants, dashboards, and adaptive applications, its value is most apparent when users need to compare options, adjust inputs, or explore information. Simple factual questions may only require a text response.

The effectiveness of Open Intelligent UI depends on the prompt, the chosen AI model, and the supported tools and components. Developers can experiment with different models to optimize response speed, cost, and adherence to prompts.
